description: Claude Code skill definitions for HOS-Forge security scanning

skills.name: nuclei_scan
skills.description: Run Nuclei vulnerability scan against a target URL, IP, or domain. Nuclei uses templates to detect various security vulnerabilities including CVEs, misconfigurations, and exposed services.

target.description: Target URL, IP address, or domain to scan (e.g. https://example.com, 192.168.1.1)

templates.description: Optional list of Nuclei template paths or tags to use (e.g. ["cves/2021/CVE-2021-44228.yaml"])

severity.description: Optional minimum severity level to report

usage_examples.command: hos skill run nuclei_scan target=https://example.com severity=high

skills.name: semgrep_scan
skills.description: Run Semgrep static analysis on source code files or directories. Semgrep detects security vulnerabilities, code quality issues, and anti-patterns across 30+ programming languages.

path.description: File or directory path to scan (e.g. ./src, ./main.py)

language.description: Optional programming language filter (python, javascript, typescript, java, go, rust, ruby, php, etc.)

config.description: Optional Semgrep rule config: 'auto' (default), 'p/security-audit', 'p/owasp-top-ten', 'p/default', or path to custom rules YAML

usage_examples.command: hos skill run semgrep_scan path=./src language=python config=p/security-audit
hos skill run semgrep_scan path=./src config=p/owasp-top-ten
